title: Holy grail with grid areas
summary: Header, nav, main, aside and footer drawn as ASCII art with grid-template-areas.
explanation: grid-template-areas names cells; each child picks its spot with grid-area. The strings form a picture of the layout, so it reads like the result.
The rows are auto 1fr auto: header and footer take their content height and main takes the rest.
At narrow widths a media query redraws the picture as one column. The HTML order never changes.
tryThis: Swap "nav" and "aside" in the areas to mirror the layout.
Set the preview to 375px to see the stacked version.
